events.label: birth
events.text: Born in Moscow, Russia.

evidence.quote: Sergey Olegovich Sirotkin was born on 27 August 1995 in Moscow , Russia

events.label: karting debut
events.text: Began karting, racing in various international series.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin began karting in 2008 and raced in various international series

events.text: Stayed with Jenzer Motorsport for second Formula Abarth season.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin remained in Formula Abarth , and with Jenzer , for a second season in 2011

events.text: Switched to Euronova Racing by Fortec before the Spa round.

evidence.quote: for a second season in 2011
But prior to the round at Spa , Sirotkin switched to the Euronova Racing by Fortec

events.text: Continued with Euronova Racing in Auto GP World Series.

evidence.quote: In 2012 , Sirotkin continued his collaboration with Euronova Racing into the Auto GP World Series

events.text: Drove for Euronova in Italian Formula Three Championship.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin also participated in the Italian Formula Three Championship in 2012 , driving for Euronova

events.text: Contested full Formula Renault 3.5 season with ISR Racing.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin expanded his Formula Renault 3.5 campaign to contest a full season in 2013 , competing with ISR Racing

events.text: Joined Sauber Formula One team as test driver.

evidence.quote: In July 2013 , Sirotkin joined the Sauber Formula One team

events.text: Switched to Fortec Motorsport, partnering Oliver Rowland.

evidence.quote: For 2014 Sirotkin switched to the Fortec Motorsport team and partnered there with Oliver Rowland

events.text: Remained Sauber test driver for 2014.

evidence.quote: He stayed in his role as test driver in 2014

events.label: F1 debut
events.text: Made F1 race-weekend debut in Russian Grand Prix free practice.

evidence.quote: free practice at the 2014 Russian Grand Prix where he recorded the 17th fastest time

events.label: superlicence
events.text: Bahrain test result earned FIA Superlicence.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin participated in tests that took place in Bahrain on 8 April

events.text: Announced GP2 Series debut with Rapax.

evidence.quote: In February 2015 , it was announced that Sirotkin would debut in the series with Rapax

events.text: Switched to defending champions ART Grand Prix in GP2.

evidence.quote: For the 2016 season , Sirotkin switched to defending champions ART Grand Prix

events.text: Announced as Renault Sport F1 development driver.

evidence.quote: In April 2016 , Sirotkins Formula One chances were revived when it was announced

events.text: Graduated from Moscow Automobile and Road Construction University.

evidence.quote: He graduated from Moscow Automobile and Road Construction University in 2017

events.text: Became Renault reserve driver.

evidence.quote: He became a reserve driver for 2017 , remaining with Renault

events.text: Raced 2017 24 Hours of Le Mans for SMP Racing.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin raced at the 2017 24 Hours of Le Mans for SMP Racing

events.text: One-round F2 return at Baku, replacing injured Albon at ART Grand Prix.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin had a one-round return to the wheel of the Dallara GP2/11 car in the 2017 FIA Formula 2 Championship at Baku

events.text: Half-day test with Williams at Yas Marina Circuit.

evidence.quote: After the 2017 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix Sirotkin had a half-day test with Williams at the Yas Marina Circuit

events.label: F1 debut
events.text: Made F1 Grand Prix debut at Australia with Williams.

evidence.quote: Sirotkin qualified 19th for his first Grand Prix in Australia

events.text: Announced by Williams as driver alongside Lance Stroll.

evidence.quote: In January 2018 , he was announced by Williams as their new driver

events.text: Served as reserve driver for McLaren and Renault.

evidence.quote: In 2019 Sirotkin served as reserve driver for the Formula One teams of both McLaren and Renault

events.text: Drove LMP1 BR1 with Sarrazin and Orudzhev.

evidence.quote: In 2019 he drove a LMP1-class BR1 together with Stéphane Sarrazin and Egor Orudzhev

events.text: Returned to ART Grand Prix for F2 pre-season testing.

evidence.quote: In 2020 Sirotkin returned to Formula 2 with ART Grand Prix for pre-season testing

events.text: Continued as Renault reserve driver.

evidence.quote: He continued as reserve driver for Renault in 2020

events.text: Signed with AF Corse to drive Ferrari 488 GT3.

evidence.quote: In 2020 , Sirotkin signed with AF Corse to drive a factory-supported Ferrari 488 GT3
